imputation_strategy: none needed: datacenter_region (the only column with missing values) is excluded from both models after an imputation comparison showed no accuracy difference; see docs/experiments/
selection_rule: Lowest MAE wins, but a more complex model (Random Forest / XGBoost) must beat Linear Regression by at least 5% relative MAE improvement to be selected over it -- otherwise the simpler, more explainable model is kept.

cpu_model.note: cpu_utilization is excluded from its own inputs to avoid target leakage.

power_model.note: cpu_utilization IS included here since power, not CPU, is the target. MAE/RMSE below are in rescaled kW (live IT-power scale), not the dataset's own kW scale -- see rescale below.

source: Real 'Green AI Data Center Telemetry' dataset (Kaggle), 10,000 rows, as uploaded by the user -- not synthetic.
